title_as_written: Arcano del mare, vol. III (autograph draft)
author: Robert Dudley
heading_as_written: Seque d'Alcune Parole della lingua Indiana ditta Trinidada et di Guiana. dirimpetto. osservati dal Duca di Northumbria quando fu in detto Paese
about: Italian-glossed list of words of the Indian language of Trinidad and the facing coast of Guiana, written in Dudley's hand as observed by the 'Duca di Northumbria' (Dudley himself) when he was in that country.
